dedupe_keys.name: anas average daily traffic on the italian national road network tgm november 2015

description: This dataset gives average daily traffic (traffico giornaliero medio, TGM) on the roads and motorways of national interest managed by ANAS in Italy, as measured by the counting stations of ANAS's PANAMA monitoring and analysis platform, with values updated to November 2015. It is published by ANAS on the open data portal of the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (dati.mit.gov.it) as an ESRI shapefile of the counted road sections, with a JSON metadata file. National coverage: the ANAS network across Italy. The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: this is a single snapshot for November 2015 even though the catalogue lists a monthly frequency, the portal entry was last modified in December 2022, and current counts must be requested from ANAS's traffic observatory; counts cover only the stations of the ANAS network. The traffic volumes serve as link loads for network flow and capacity planning models and to weight road links in hazard exposure and criticality studies. The dataset is related to the ANAS road graph record, which supplies the network geometry the counts can be joined to.
name: ANAS average daily traffic on the Italian national road network (TGM, November 2015)
provider: ANAS (Direzione generale), published on the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport open data portal
